strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你只看重强大、珍稀,{NEWLINE}却对云云众生毫无尊重、{CLEAR}对自己家乡毫无感情,{CLEAR}你这种人根本就不配成为训练家！

strings.zh: 小豪『你赢了我又怎么样！{NEWLINE}你有资格在这里耀武扬威,{CLEAR}不就是仗着你比我强吗？{CLEAR}你这种以最强为目标的人,{CLEAR}有什么资格说强大不重要,{CLEAR}有什么资格说我不对！{SCROLL}小豪『你等着吧,{NEWLINE}总有一天我会用更强的精灵打败你。
strings.en: Goh: So what if you beat me?! The{NEWLINE}only reason you get to strut around{CLEAR}here is that you’re stronger than{CLEAR}me! You’re aiming to be the strongest{CLEAR}yourself. What right do you have to{CLEAR}say strength doesn’t matter? What{CLEAR}right do you have to say I’m wrong?!{SCROLL}Goh: Just you wait. Someday I’ll beat{NEWLINE}you with even stronger Pokémon.

strings.zh: 桔梗市是我的家乡,{NEWLINE}在我心中她就是最美的地方。
strings.en: Violet City is my hometown. To me, she’s{NEWLINE}the most beautiful place there is.

strings.zh: 谢谢你帮我出头说话,{NEWLINE}生命的意义、生活的美好{CLEAR}绝不是像他说的那样{CLEAR}只有强大、珍稀才有价值。{SCROLL}这个送给你,{NEWLINE}就当是我对你的感谢吧。
strings.en: Thank you for standing up for me.{NEWLINE}The meaning of life and the good{CLEAR}things in it aren’t only about being{CLEAR}strong and rare, like he said.{SCROLL}Please take this as my thanks.

strings.zh: 前几天因为玛力露{NEWLINE}弄脏了我的新衣服,{CLEAR}我就狠狠地说了它一通。{CLEAR}结果今天它好像离家出走了……{SCROLL}如果你有在桔梗市看到玛力露,{NEWLINE}拜托跟它说一声让它快点回来吧,{CLEAR}我真的非常担心它。
strings.en: The other day, my Marill got my{NEWLINE}new clothes dirty, so I really{CLEAR}told it off. And today, it looks{CLEAR}like it ran away from home...{SCROLL}If you see Marill in Violet City,{NEWLINE}please tell it to hurry home.{CLEAR}I’m really worried about it.

strings.zh: 我以后一定注意{NEWLINE}跟玛力露的说话方式,{CLEAR}不会再伤害到它了。
strings.en: From now on, I’ll be careful{NEWLINE}how I talk to Marill. I won’t{CLEAR}hurt its feelings again.

strings.en: My Marill slipped away when I{NEWLINE}wasn’t looking, and it never came{CLEAR}back... *sigh*... Once a bond{CLEAR}cracks, it’s so hard to mend...

strings.zh: 你说多次劝说玛力露无果后,{NEWLINE}它就跑得无影无踪了！？{CLEAR}都怪我说话太狠才会让它这么伤心。{SCROLL}谢谢你帮我去找玛力露,{NEWLINE}这个送给你吧。
